articles.title: Andy Burnham faces his first Labour rebellion over Rosebank oil field as ministers threaten to quit and 100 MPs demand project is blocked
articles.summary: In a letter, the group said they were 'increasingly concerned that the approval of the Rosebank oil field would permanently damage our climate credentials as a party and as a country'.

articles.title: Rosebank rebellion: are resignations next? – podcast
articles.summary: Close to 100 Labour MPs have sent a letter to Andy Burnham calling for him to reject the Rosebank oilfield licence.
